Waver names the inner operation of vacillating: turning this way and that, or doubting the promise.
Weigh names the inner operation of judging what is said: let the others weigh what is said.
Weigh here is weighing silver or goods on a scale; no inner operation.
Weighing names the inner operation of pondering: the Preacher weighing and studying and arranging proverbs.
